results.guards: the ordinary case: one row label, one column, one changed value
results.name: positive_markdown_table_default

results.guards: a row that did not change is not a currency question
results.name: negative_unchanged_row_is_not_a_fact

results.guards: a th/td row is a source-native key/value and must be read as one
results.name: positive_html_infobox_row

results.guards: a renamed option is a different property, not a changed value
results.name: adversarial_renamed_key

results.guards: 1,200 and 1200 are the same value; the scorer says so and so must this
results.name: adversarial_typography_only

results.guards: a version becoming a date is not a single-kind contrast
results.name: adversarial_value_kind_change

results.guards: a label carrying a value would put part of the answer in the question
results.name: adversarial_label_contains_a_number

results.guards: two rows claiming one key is ambiguity, not a choice of ordinal
results.name: adversarial_duplicate_row_label

results.guards: nested pattern matches must not make a version look like two values
results.name: positive_version_chain_is_one_value

results.guards: dominance is span containment, not string containment
results.name: adversarial_two_values_at_their_own_positions

results.guards: a cell holding two tokens binds no single value
results.name: adversarial_range_is_not_a_value

results.guards: answering from a neighbouring change is not currency selection
results.name: adversarial_atom_carries_a_second_changed_number

results.guards: the generated question must be blind to both values
results.name: adversarial_question_never_states_a_value

property_taxonomy.grammars: markdown pipe tables, HTML tables with a header row
property_taxonomy.label_from: the first cell of the row, under the named column header
the row's th, with the value in the td beside it

results.guards: the ordinary success case
results.name: positive_current_value

results.guards: the stale answer must not score as a success
results.name: negative_superseded_value

results.guards: reciting both is not selecting one
results.name: ambiguous_both_values

results.guards: a refusal is not a current-value success
results.name: no_value_at_all

results.guards: typography must not decide the endpoint
results.name: thousands_separator_is_the_same_value

results.guards: 42 inside 4200 is not the value 42
results.name: substring_is_not_a_match

results.guards: a unicode dash must not hide a date
results.name: unicode_dash_and_case_are_normalised

results.guards: normalisation must not merge two genuinely different values
results.name: decimal_precision_is_not_collapsed

scorer_unchanged.rule: byte-identical to the version MODEL_ENDPOINT_V1 froze
